response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'High side of 47.6 cutoff' is interpreted as bandusagepct > 47.6 (strictly greater than), not >= 47.6

alternatives.interpretation: If 'high side of 47.6 cutoff' includes the boundary value itself, use >= 47.6
